item.title: Tumaini Trial Launch: WHO begins Ebola vaccine study in DRC; aims to protect against Bundibugyo strain
item.description: In a historic move, the World Health Organization has launched its inaugural clinical trial for an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of Congo. This trial aims to assess the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine against the Bundibugyo virus amid a severe outbreak that has resulted in over 9,700 cases and 4,600 fatalities since May.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Selena Gomez’s charity benefit raises $2.7 M for mental health
item.description: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. During the event, she reaffirmed her dedication to youth mental health and introduced the Katherine Short Legacy Award, with a remarkable total of $2.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: Giant waves crash into Taiwan as Typhoon Champi leaves over 500 injured; 1 dead
item.description: Typhoon Champi made landfall in Taiwan, resulting in one casualty and more than 500 injuries reported. The storm brought heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages affecting over 167,000 homes. Over 240 flights were canceled due to severe weather conditions impacting transport services. Schools and offices were closed for an extended period as a precautionary measure against the storm.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Mrbeast Bets On Ai Toy: Star takes 55% of Ball 2; viral hype must prove lasting demand
item.description: MrBeast invested $250,000 for a 55% stake in Ball 2, an AI-powered toy, during his debut on Shark Tank. Created by Andrew Brown and Kevin Langdon, the ball uses sensors and a companion app to track movement and generate interactive games. While MrBeast backed its viral potential, investors Kevin O'Leary and Lori Greiner questioned consumer demand. The product's success now depends on turning online attention into lasting sales.

item.title: Rhode Island volunteers reused 600+ Christmas trees to restore riverbanks and protect young trout
item.description: In an inspiring environmental effort, volunteers in Rhode Island gathered over 600 old Christmas trees for the 'Trees for Trout' initiative, aimed at restoring riverbanks. By bringing their discarded trees to designated collection sites at Arcadia Management Area, residents have made a significant contribution toward creating sustainable trout habitats and mitigating soil erosion. This project not only enhances local waterways but also promotes community involvement in ecological preservation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Portia gifted Ellen a Rwanda gorilla project in 2018; its campus welcomed 40,000+ visitors by 2023
item.description: Portia de Rossi gifted Ellen DeGeneres a conservation project which led to the Ellen DeGeneres Campus opening in Rwanda. The campus supports wildlife protection and offers educational opportunities for local students and communities. Since its opening, it has welcomed numerous visitors and hosted thousands of Rwandan schoolchildren for science lessons. The project emphasizes sustainable practices and aims to monitor and protect endangered mountain gorillas.

item.title: Couple buy a California apple farm and build a cider business
item.description: David Bailey and Dana Tiel left their advertising careers to purchase a 16-acre farm in California. After spending $1 million, they converted a barn loft into their home. Their farm, Sierra Cider, includes a petting zoo, pumpkin patch and cider tastings. The couple faced challenges while balancing work and renovations during their transition. Despite initial doubts, the farm has become a popular destination for families and children.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Inside Chloë Grace Moretz’s former $5.65 M Los Angeles home
item.description: Chloë Grace Moretz purchased a $3.4 million home in Studio City in 2016 and hosted numerous gatherings there. After seven years, she listed the property for almost $6 million and sold it for $5.65 million. The home features multiple entertainment spaces, a separate studio, and luxurious outdoor areas. Studio City remains a popular area for high-profile buyers, including Olivia Wilde, who sold her property in December 2025.

item.title: How Cameron Diaz turned a $1.8 Million home into $4.9 million
item.description: Ariana Grande acquired Cameron Diaz's Hollywood Hills property in 2022 through an off-market deal worth $4.9 million. The home features two bedrooms, two-and-a-half bathrooms, and is situated at the end of a cul-de-sac. Cameron Diaz originally bought the house in 2004 for $1.8 million but never lived there. The property underwent many renovations during Diaz's ownership, enhancing its condition before Grande's purchase.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Alicia Keys and Swizz Beatz bought a $20.8M California cliffside home in 2019
item.description: Alicia Keys and Swizz Beatz made a significant purchase in 2019, acquiring the Razor House in La Jolla for $20.8 million. This architectural masterpiece, designed by Wallace E. Cunningham, boasts panoramic Pacific Ocean views. The duo transformed this modern creation into a warm family abode, enriched with artworks from the Dean Collection, reflecting Swizz Beatz's dream of a creative hideaway and highlighting the prestige of California's architectural landscape.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Aspen Estate Sale Closes: Slack and Away founders net $5m gain; sale not linked to separation
item.description: Stewart Butterfield and Jen Rubio recently finalized the sale of their Aspen estate for $30 million, right after their separation. They originally acquired the property for around $25 million in January 2021, yielding a nice profit despite initially aiming for $45 million. The estate has been purchased by David and Erika Sands, professional poker players, who now add it to their diverse real estate holdings across New York and California.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Bob Barker’s historic Los Angeles mansion sells for $6.325 million after renovation
item.description: A charming piece of Hollywood Hills history, the home once owned by Bob Barker has seen an impressive makeover. Julia Dempster, the interior designer, cleverly blended modern enhancements with the house's original charm, showcasing stunning stained-glass windows and wrought iron accents. Originally listed at over $8 million, it found a new owner, Randy Pitchford, for $6.325 million in spring 2026, further enriching his portfolio of Hollywood landmarks.

item.title: Jason Momoa’s water brand expands hotel refill machines after removing 6 million plastic bottles
item.description: Mananalu, founded by Jason Momoa, aims to eliminate single-use plastic bottles through innovative refill systems. The newly implemented technology connects to local water sources and fills reusable containers. This approach also significantly reduces carbon emissions associated with traditional bottled water. Initiatives are starting in Hawaii, where waste management is crucial due to heavy reliance on imported water.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: 1890 Sherlock Holmes first edition found in charity shop sells for £11,520
item.description: A first-edition edition of The Sign of Four surfaced among the book donations at an Oxfam shop, piquing the interest of staff who recognized its rare value. After seeking expert appraisal, the book fetched an impressive £11,520 at Bonhams auction house. The funds raised will greatly benefit Oxfam's humanitarian efforts globally, highlighting how valuable donations can be when assessed properly.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
